title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 17: the riddle of the two eagles and the vine, the broken covenant, and the tender twig planted on a high mountain.

questions.text: What was the prophet told to tell the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to tell a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel.

questions.text: What came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar?
questions.explanation: A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

questions.text: Where did it plant the topmost of the cedar's young twigs?
questions.explanation: It cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, carried it to a land of traffic, and planted it in a city of merchants.

answers.text: By a river in the wilderness
In the garden of the king

questions.text: What did the seed of the land become when it grew?
questions.explanation: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him and whose roots were under him.

answers.text: A thicket of thorns and briers
A spreading vine of low stature

questions.text: Toward what did the vine bend its roots in verse 7?
questions.explanation: There was another great eagle, and the vine bent its roots toward him and shot out its branches toward him, that he might water it.

answers.text: Toward the trees of the forest

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will make the vine utterly wither?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether it will prosper, and says it will utterly wither when the east wind touches it.

questions.text: Who came to Jerusalem and took its king and princes to Babylon?
questions.explanation: The prophet is told to say that the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its princes to Babylon.

questions.text: To whom did he send his ambassadors when he rebelled?
questions.explanation: He rebelled by sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people.

questions.text: Where does Yahweh say the man who broke the covenant will die?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that in the place where the king dwells who made him king, even with him in the middle of Babylon, he will die.

answers.text: In the middle of the wilderness

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will plant on a high and lofty mountain?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will take a tender one from the topmost of the cedar's young twigs and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

answers.text: A tender twig from the top of the cedar
